newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane mixed, activity very quiet.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane mixed, activity very quiet.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were mixed in very thin trade late Thursday, but prices were notional given the lack of players in the market.
Many players were still out of their offices due to the Christmas holiday on Wednesday and activity was expected to be light until the New Year.
Spot propane in the Midwest trading hub of Conway, Kansas, was talked between 74.00 cents and 75.00 cents a gallon, one cent above midday levels.
Mont Belvieu prices slipped another quarter cent, however, amid warmer-than-expected forecasts for the U.S. Northeast.
((-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631))
